observations.behavior: Replaces conditional rendering based on feature flag with unconditional UI. The previous code checked `notificationEntrypointVariant` from a feature flag to decide between an alert-only dropdown or subscriptions; this hunk removes that check.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes reliance on the removed FEATURE_FLAG constant, changing behavior for users regardless of their assigned variant. This could affect discoverability and routing if the intended A/B test is no longer active or misconfigured.

observations.code_quote: INSIGHT_NOTIFICATION_ENTRYPOINT: 'insight-notification-entrypoint', // owner: #team-product-analytics multivariate=control,notifications,get-updates,monitor — tests notification-entry-point copy against the prominent Subscribe button
observations.behavior: Deletes a specific entry from the shared FEATURE_FLAGS object. No other hunks retain its value, indicating it was not used elsewhere after removal.
observations.posthog_connection: Eliminates support for one branch of an A/B experiment. If dependent downstream configuration still expects this key, compatibility may break unless migration handled separately.

observations.behavior: Removes the entire switch statement including all cases and the helper function. All three variants are discarded in favor of a single static label.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes user-facing text and potentially associated event payloads. The implementation does not preserve alternative labels or provide fallbacks, which could reduce information conveyed to end-users.

observations.limitations: Only frontend changes reviewed; backend ingestion, warehouse connectors, and database migrations are absent. No release notes or adoption metrics provided. Test assertions do not demonstrate preservation of behavior across variants.

review.limitations: Only frontend changes reviewed; backend ingestion, warehouse connectors, and database migrations are absent. No release notes or adoption metrics provided. Test assertions do not demonstrate preservation of behavior across variants.
review.reason: The change removes conditional branching based on a feature flag and replaces it with a fixed UI, while also deleting the corresponding constant. This is a substantive bounded capability improvement (removing experimental complexity) but lacks broader systemic risk reduction or cross-component dependency restructuring that would warrant tier 3. Tier 1 is too narrow given the removal of multiple related hunks and shared constants.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog's analytics dashboard UX and subscription management. Removing an A/B variant without retaining its support could affect users assigned to specific test groups if no compatible configuration exists downstream.
review.uncertainty: Without access to migration status, dependent services, or complete rollout context, cannot assess compatibility risks or actual benefit realization.
